sourceObservation.method: Fresh sport/year/brand/program selector reads and full checklist downloads. Original data URI strings retrieved in complete bounded chunks to avoid transport clipping; validated ten original columns and each row metadata. Both duplicate Fight Contenders options were selected independently: first header-only, second populated. Original source bytes and hashes retained; complete exports imported without combining or inventing rows. Source year and season labels do not establish calendar-year release. Product-guide, exact release-date and exhaustive numbering reconciliation remain incomplete.

sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 2,333 rows from the official Panini CSV export are retained, including all original columns, literal card-set parallel names and SEQUENCE values. Empty numbering is not an estimate. Pack odds are absent from this export. Product year does not establish a release date. This export was observed in the official interface on 2026-10-21; that observation is not a release date. Printed card-set identities naming other products are retained. Full product-guide and calendar-release reconciliation remain pending.
